title: Smokey Pho
description: A hearty, comforting dish inspired by the flavors of Vietnam. This smokey pho is a twist on the classic noodle soup, featuring tender beef and a rich, aromatic broth.
instructions: In a large stockpot, combine beef brisket, onion, ginger, star anise, and cinnamon stick.
Pour in 4 cups of cold water and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Strain the broth through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean pot, discarding the solids.
Add pho spice blend, fish sauce, soy sauce, and sugar to the broth.
Bring the broth to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes.
Cook the smokey rice according to package directions.
Slice the cooked beef into thin strips.
Assemble the pho by placing cooked rice and beef into bowls, then ladling the hot broth over the top.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
